draft.subject: ML Engineer, Generative Video role at Mirage
draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I recently graduated with an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I noticed you occasionally recruit for engineering and ML roles, so I wanted to reach out about the ML Engineer, Generative Video opening.

The role calls for deep learning systems experience with PyTorch and CUDA, which lines up with most of what I have built. I have written custom CUDA kernels to speed up inference, used quantization to shrink a language model down with almost no loss in accuracy, and built a real time perception and control pipeline that needed to stay fast end to end. Most of this comes from internships and independent projects rather than a full time role, so I want to be upfront that the years on paper are thinner than the posting asks for, even though the work itself holds up.

This might sit outside your usual focus, but if it is something you handle, I would love to send my resume over.
draft.hook_used: her profile states she occasionally recruits for engineering & ML roles
